verdict.rationale: OCI documents an official CLI that offers the same core functionality as the Console plus extra commands. It installs on Oracle Linux, macOS (Homebrew), Windows and Linux/Unix, comes pre-configured in Cloud Shell, and supports token-based auth without a keypair; a probe also confirms the official CLI docs. missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly traits (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive scripting guidance), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
